description: This file implements several commands related to managing references in a Git repository, including migrating reference storage formats, verifying references, listing references, checking existence, and optimizing reference storage. It contains command handlers and associated option parsing for 'git refs' subcommands.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_migrate(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git refs migrate' command, allowing migration of reference storage format with options for dry-run and skipping reflog.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_verify(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git refs verify' command, performing consistency checks on references with options for verbosity and strictness.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'git refs list' command, listing references in the repository.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_exists(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git refs exists' command, checking if a specific reference exists.

methods.name: int cmd_refs_optimize(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'git refs optimize' command, optimizing reference storage.

methods.name: int cmd_refs(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function dispatching 'git refs' subcommands based on user input.
